text: How do you really know if a first date went well? Because sometimes you think it went amazing, there was flirting, kissing, she laughed, and then nothing. No second date. Other times it felt neat, but she texts you herself and asks, when will you meet again? Here are four signs that can tell you that the date actually went well. Sign one, you kiss her. Ideally, the French kiss with a tongue, whether in the middle of the date or in the end of it. Sign two, there was some physical contact between you two. Whether it was holding hands, playful touches, or her leaning in close, physical contact is a strong sign of comfort and attraction. Sign three, there was real laughter and connection. Like you both forgot the world existed. Sign four, she texts you first after the date, thanking you and saying she had a good time. But here's the twist. Even if you did everything right, life happens. Her ex might show up with a new gift for her or something flipped in her world, and now she's busy with other things. Point is, it might have nothing to do with you. Generally speaking, if the first date felt great, it probably was a great first date. So trust your intuition. Don't overthink it and ask her on a second date.
